About the Vessel

Built for the Santa Barbara Channel

Finaddict is a 41-ft custom built Radon Sportfisher with a flying bridge and integrated swim step. Radon boats are locally built in Santa Barbara and are renowned for their strength, stability, and comfortable ride.

Custom built and designed for offshore sportfishing and specialty trips, Finaddict was completely rebuilt from bow to stern in 2016 — making her the newest, largest, and most well-appointed charter boat in the Santa Barbara Harbor.

  • ▸Sleeps up to 6 passengers and 3 crew comfortably
  • ▸Hot and cold running fresh water throughout
  • ▸Private restroom/shower enclosed outside the cabin
  • ▸Equipped with a water maker for longer trips
  • ▸Flush deck and 1¼" stainless steel rails for safety
  • ▸Flood lights illuminate entire deck for night trips
Technical Specifications

Complete Vessel Data

Vessel Specifications — M/V Finaddict
Hull41-ft custom Radon Sportfisher — locally built in Santa Barbara, CA. Completely rebuilt bow to stern in 2016.
PropulsionTwin 435 horsepower Volvo Penta D6-435 diesel engines — new, reliable offshore performance.
Speed & RangeCruising speed up to 20 knots. Operating range of 400 miles.
Generator12.5 kW onboard generator providing 110V and 220V throughout the vessel. Charge all electrical devices underway.
Water SystemsHot and cold running fresh water. Equipped with an onboard water maker for extended offshore trips.
CapacityUp to 6 passengers and 3 crew. Large cockpit with plenty of room to spare. 100% private charter — your group only.
Fishing Systems1-ton insulated fish hold below deck. 10-scoop live bait tank. Large cockpit with transom door for swim step access. Built-in ice chest supplementing the galley refrigerator.
ElectronicsFull Raymarine suite: depth sounder, chart plotter, 48-mile radar, autopilot — duplicated on the bridge. Second GPS and chart plotter. Two VHF marine radios. 406 MHz Category 1 EPIRB.
SafetyAnnual voluntary U.S. Coast Guard inspection. Fire and safety equipment exceeds minimum requirements. Flush deck with 1¼" stainless steel rails. Flood lighting for full deck coverage on night trips.
Head & FacilitiesPrivate restroom/shower enclosed outside the main cabin. Hot water shower and flushing toilet.
CabinBunks for 6 passengers. Two dining/work tables. Galley with microwave, refrigerator, fresh water sink, and built-in coffee maker. Separate red and white cabin lighting for night use.
Deck & CockpitLarge cockpit accommodating 6 passengers comfortably. Transom door for easy swim step access. Outdoor BBQ grill for multi-day trips.
Flying BridgeFull flybridge with integrated swim step. Electronics duplicated on bridge, in constant communication with lower helm.
Propulsion

Twin Volvo Penta D6-435

Finaddict is powered by twin 435 horsepower Volvo Penta D6-435 diesel engines — new, proven offshore powerplants renowned for reliability and fuel efficiency.

A 12.5 kilowatt onboard generator provides 110V and 220V power throughout the vessel, so passengers can charge phones, laptops, and any other electrical devices during the trip.

With a cruising speed of 20 knots and a 400-mile operating range, Finaddict can reach the Channel Islands and beyond with ease.

Navigation & Safety Electronics

Raymarine Suite

The helm is equipped with the latest Raymarine electronics — depth sounder, chart plotter, 48-mile radar, and autopilot. All instruments are duplicated on the flying bridge and continuously communicate with one another.

Additional equipment includes a second GPS and chart plotter, two VHF marine radios, and a 406 MHz Category 1 EPIRB. Though not required by Coast Guard regulations, Finaddict undergoes a voluntary annual USCG inspection — and fire and safety equipment exceed all minimum requirements.

Safety & Standards

Designed with safety in mind

Voluntary USCG Inspection
Although not required by United States Coast Guard regulations, Finaddict undergoes a voluntary Coast Guard inspection annually. Fire and safety equipment exceed the minimum requirements.
406 MHz Category 1 EPIRB
Equipped with a Category 1 EPIRB, two VHF marine radios, and redundant GPS systems. All electronics are duplicated on both the helm and flybridge and communicate continuously.
Structural Safety
Flush deck design with 1¼" sturdy stainless steel rails around the entire boat. Flood lights illuminate the full deck and foredeck for safe night-time operations.

Private sportfishing, whale watching, and coastal adventures aboard the Finaddict. Departing from Santa Barbara Harbor.
